behavior.codec: Additive rf1086-production-archive-v5 requires source, override and withdrawal histories. Canonical withdrawal receipts retain original actor-scoped recovery keys; exact target and full supplied lineage are validated without deleting historical evidence or reactivating ancestors.
behavior.coverage: None remains unknown; empty tuple means captured-empty. Parsing supplied records cannot prove that a storage producer enumerated every row.
behavior.sourceEvidence: rf1086-source-v3 binds withdrawal receipts and independently supplied family count, rejects missing/mismatched coverage and inconsistent archive/workspace overrides. Current adapter still supplies unknown withdrawal coverage.
behavior.compatibility: Archive-v1 through-v4 bytes and source-v1/v2 evidence hashes remain unchanged. Old RF JSON and stream routes explicitly project their existing codec and unknown withdrawal coverage; no new v5 HTTP route, SQL write port or generated client.
behavior.offlineVerification: CLI supports v5 JSON/NDJSON and --require-register-withdrawal-history; reports captured/count independently from originals and database restore. Five original source generations remain verified in the synthetic stream fixtures.
